PLAN "Deload Week: Post-Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "deload and recovery"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Lower Body Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 2x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          superman 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Push Focus Deload":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dip 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Focus Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
          neck_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday training 45m "Lower Body Deload 2":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          sumo_deadlift 2x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Mobility & Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          spinal_twist 2x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          forward_fold 2x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 2m
          butterfly_stretch 2m

PLAN "Last Week Hypertrophy Volume Calculation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "calculate last week volume"

PHASES
  PHASE "Hypertrophy Block Final Week" (1 week):
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Upper Body Hypertrophy":
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 75m "Lower Body Hypertrophy":
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Active Recovery":
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          superman 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 75m "Push Focus Hypertrophy":
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 75m "Pull Focus Hypertrophy":
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x15 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Saturday training 75m "Lower Body Hypertrophy 2":
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          sumo_deadlift 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Sunday training 45m "Mobility & Recovery":
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          spinal_twist 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          forward_fold 3x45s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds

# Volume per session (working sets):
# Monday: 4+4+3+3+2+2 = 18 sets
# Tuesday: 4+4+3+3+2 = 16 sets
# Wednesday: 3+3+3 = 9 sets (active recovery)
# Thursday: 4+3+3+3+2 = 15 sets
# Friday: 4+4+3+2+3 = 16 sets
# Saturday: 4+4+3+3+2 = 16 sets
# Sunday: 3+3+3 = 9 sets (mobility/recovery)
